title: Canadian national Connor Moucka pleads guilty to participating in the 2024 Snowflake hacks involving data theft from at least 165 companies, including AT&T (Jonathan Greig/The Record)
summary: Jonathan Greig / The Record: Canadian national Connor Moucka pleads guilty to participating in the 2024 Snowflake hacks involving data theft from at least 165 companies, including AT&T — A Canadian national is facing decades in prison for participating in the hacking of data storage platform Snowflake.
